openers: Post a photo of the sorted Saturday donations
Ask who can cover Thursday's pickup route
Remind everyone the storeroom key is with Bin

private_lines.Ting: You teach at a primary school in Chengdu, so your weekdays go to lessons, marking and preparing for the next day. You live with your husband and your seven-year-old son in an apartment across town, and on weekends you volunteer at the food bank while your son spends the afternoon with his grandparents.
private_lines.Bin: You are retired from a career as a civil engineer and live alone in an older apartment complex in Chengdu. Your mornings start with a walk and tai chi in the park, afternoons go to reading and tidying the flat, and you volunteer on Tuesdays and Saturdays.
private_lines.Haoran: You work as a delivery rider in Chengdu, mostly in the evenings and at lunchtime rushes, and you share a rented room with two other riders in a older district. Your days start late and run into the night, and you fit in food bank shifts on weekend mornings when you are not on a delivery schedule.
private_lines.Yuting: You work as a buyer for a supermarket in Chengdu, so your weekdays follow regular office hours and supplier calls. You live with your mother in a family flat, and you usually spend your evenings cooking and watching television, with food bank shifts on weekend mornings.

text: Anyone free to cover thursday's pickup route? I have an observation that morning
7:30 from the shops on the east side, usually done by 9:30. Bakery is the big one, takes the longest
I can do that. Thursday is free for me.
thu morning i'm asleep till 8 😅 can do after 9 if that works? not before
After 9 is fine, bin can start and you can take the bakery after if that's ok
I have a supplier call at 9 on thursdays, sorry. But I have surplus rice and cooking oil from last week if anyone wants to take it on the route
Yes please. Can it go to the storeroom?
Yes I'll send the pallet info tonight
is the bakery still doing the bread on thursday or just the weekend one
Not sure, I'll ask them tomorrow when I'm at the shop
[photo: pallet label, 40 bags rice 5kg, 12 bottles oil]
That's the stock. Bags are sealed
Received. Bin will pick up the sheet at the storeroom on Tuesday and check the count.
bakery replied to my message, they said thursday yes but only till 10 🥖
so bin do bakery first then?
